notes.title: Jun, 23 / 2018:1.18 update (minor)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello again!!![/h1]

Finally got the reverse command in such way it does not make the TurbOT to look weird, you can now use S key on keyboard or A in gamepads and from 1.18 and beyound you also can to recharge your turbos with gamepad shoulders buttons (L1 - R1).

[h1]About recharge: I am planing let the shoulders as default to this operation, please let me know if I can kill this on D-PAD[/h1]

Some VFX effects also got freed from components / speed improvement, so probably you will get nice anime like speed traces and some screen distortion until with lower chassis and power sources.

Some tracks were also rebalanced as the crash penalties were lowered to improve budget progression.

Cheers!

creasso

notes.title: 06/12/2018 - Minor update (1.15) New Achievement Requisites
notes.notes:
Hello!

Well, I have been playing the game a lot while testing some systems and noticed that due to the repair cost (yep, I do collide a lot LOL) some achievements were a bit unbalanced.

To fix this from now on 2 achievements have lesser requirements to be triggered, since its just a small change is not enough to call this the 1.2 version.

Just update your game and play it, I will be watching the statistics. ːsteammockingː


Thank you all by the support to the game!


creasso

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1 - MOUSE STEERING SUPPORT (Check Video)
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Now we do not need a controller to get "soft" turn on the game!
After some research and tests looks like I just needed a small visual support on HUD to get an experience so good as on a gamepad ( to be sincere I am preferring the keyboard+mouse now ːsteamhappyː ), so it is not a reccomendation now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32392177/a465d5477ca873e0baf562b32ac8ece9da483a64.jpg[/img]

This put the game on a perfect path to any plan I get on the future and I hope all you also like this new control scheme.

I did also small changes on some tracks to tune the difficulty, so, get the achievements and credits to buy parts will be a lot more rewarding.


Cheers!

notes.title: Balance update coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello!

After some tests here I am preparing to make some changes on the game.
The affected areas will be on keyboard controls and difficult curve, changes will probably result on a better experience to everyone and get things already in place to further expansions.

The update will take place on the next weeks and I will announce it here.

I thank you all by the support.

cheers!

creasso
